answer: Anchor every new agent to a locked bond it cannot spend. First, registration locks 30 tokens in a 21-day escrow. Second, the agent works only jobs from the shared atlas of low-risk tasks, earnings kept in escrow too. Third, 30 flagged-free jobs confirmed by 5 different client ledgers release the escrow. Fourth, one proven fraud burns bond plus earnings. So each identity stands on a narrow ledge: a 100-agent sybil farm locks 3,000 tokens and 1,000 hours of supervised work for zero spendable return before release. Like climbers sharing one anchor: a fake harness drags itself off the ledge.
